description: Test whether the ICY1 conserved C-terminal block corresponds to the equivalent region of its paralog ATG41, and whether the AlphaFold model of ATG41 (Q12048) shows the same single-helix, disorder-dominated architecture as ICY1
code:
import requests, numpy as np, json, os, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)

def get_seq(acc):
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta", timeout=60)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

ICY1 = get_seq("Q04329")
ATG41 = get_seq("Q12048")
print("ICY1 ", len(ICY1), ICY1)
print("ATG41", len(ATG41), ATG41)

# ---- BLOSUM62 (compact) ----
B62_ROWS = """A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
AAS = "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B = {}
for line in B62_ROWS.strip().split("\n"):
    p = line.split()
    for j, v in enumerate(p[1:]):
        B[(p[0], AAS[j])] = int(v)
def sc(a, b): return B.get((a, b), -4)

def smith_waterman(q, t, go=-11, ge=-1):
    n, m = len(q), len(t)
    H = np.zeros((n+1, m+1)); E = np.full((n+1, m+1), -1e9); F = np.full((n+1, m+1), -1e9)
    P = np.zeros((n+1, m+1), int)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(1, m+1):
            E[i, j] = max(E[i, j-1] + ge, H[i, j-1] + go + ge)
            F[i, j] = max(F[i-1, j] + ge, H[i-1, j] + go + ge)
            d = H[i-1, j-1] + sc(q[i-1], t[j-1])
            best = max(0.0, d, E[i, j], F[i, j])
            H[i, j] = best
            P[i, j] = 0 if best == 0 else (1 if best == d else (2 if best == E[i, j] else 3))
    i, j = np.unravel_index(np.argmax(H), H.shape)
    score = H[i, j]
    aq, at, pairs = [], [], []
    while i > 0 and j > 0 and H[i, j] > 0:
        p = P[i, j]
        if p == 1:
            aq.append(q[i-1]); at.append(t[j-1]); pairs.append((i, j)); i -= 1; j -= 1
        elif p == 2:
            aq.append("-"); at.append(t[j-1]); j -= 1
        else:
            aq.append(q[i-1]); at.append("-"); i -= 1
    return score, "".join(aq[::-1]), "".join(at[::-1]), pairs[::-1]

score, aq, at, pairs = smith_waterman(ICY1, ATG41)
ident = sum(1 for a, b in zip(aq, at) if a == b and a != "-")
pos   = sum(1 for a, b in zip(aq, at) if a != "-" and b != "-" and sc(a, b) > 0)
alen  = len(aq)
print(f"\nICY1 vs ATG41: score={score:.0f} alnLen={alen} id={ident} ({100*ident/alen:.1f}%) pos={pos} ({100*pos/alen:.1f}%)")

# Which ATG41 residues align to the conserved ICY1 block 106-127?
blk = [(i, j) for (i, j) in pairs if 106 <= i <= 127]
print("ICY1 106-127 maps to ATG41", blk[0][1], "-", blk[-1][1],
      " identities in block:", sum(1 for (i, j) in blk if ICY1[i-1] == ATG41[j-1]), "/", len(blk))
for key_pos in [113, 116, 117, 119, 120, 121, 122, 123, 124]:
    m = [j for (i, j) in pairs if i == key_pos]
    if m:
        print(f"  ICY1 {ICY1[key_pos-1]}{key_pos}  ->  ATG41 {ATG41[m[0]-1]}{m[0]}  {'MATCH' if ICY1[key_pos-1]==ATG41[m[0]-1] else 'diff'}")

# ---- AlphaFold models: pLDDT + secondary structure proxy for both paralogs ----
def af_ca_plddt(acc):
    meta = requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}", timeout=60).json()[0]
    pdb = requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"], timeout=120).text
    ca, pl = [], []
    for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip() == "CA":
            ca.append([float(ln[30:38]), float(ln[38:46]), float(ln[46:54])])
            pl.append(float(ln[60:66]))
    with open(f"out/AF-{acc}.pdb", "w") as f:
        f.write(pdb)
    return np.array(ca), np.array(pl)

ca1, pl1 = af_ca_plddt("Q04329")
ca2, pl2 = af_ca_plddt("Q12048")

def geom(ca, pl, name):
    n = len(ca)
    D = np.linalg.norm(ca[:, None] - ca[None], axis=-1)
    lr = int(((D < 8.0) & np.triu(np.ones_like(D, bool), k=12)).sum())
    Rg = float(np.sqrt(((ca - ca.mean(0))**2).sum(1).mean()))
    Rg_exp = 2.2 * n**0.38
    out = dict(protein=name, n=n, mean_pLDDT=float(pl.mean()),
               frac_pLDDT_lt70=float((pl < 70).mean()),
               long_range_contacts=lr, Rg=Rg, Rg_expected_globular=Rg_exp,
               Rg_ratio=Rg / Rg_exp)
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
    return out

g1 = geom(ca1, pl1, "ICY1 Q04329")
g2 = geom(ca2, pl2, "ATG41 Q12048")

# high-confidence (pLDDT>=70) stretches
def stretches(pl, thr=70, minlen=5):
    out, s = [], None
    for i, v in enumerate(pl):
        if v >= thr and s is None: s = i
        if v < thr and s is not None:
            if i - s >= minlen: out.append((s+1, i))
            s = None
    if s is not None and len(pl) - s >= minlen: out.append((s+1, len(pl)))
    return out
print("ICY1  pLDDT>=70 segments:", stretches(pl1))
print("ATG41 pLDDT>=70 segments:", stretches(pl2))

# ---- figure ----
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
a = ax[0, 0]
a.plot(np.arange(1, len(pl1)+1), pl1, color="#1f77b4", lw=1.6, label="ICY1 Q04329")
a.plot(np.arange(1, len(pl2)+1), pl2, color="#d62728", lw=1.6, label="ATG41 Q12048")
a.axhline(70, ls="--", c="grey", lw=1)
a.axvspan(106, 127, color="gold", alpha=0.25)
a.set_xlabel("residue"); a.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); a.set_title("Both ohnologs: one confident segment, the rest disordered")
a.legend(fontsize=8)

a = ax[0, 1]
labels = ["ICY1", "ATG41"]
a.bar([0, 1], [g1["long_range_contacts"], g2["long_range_contacts"]], color=["#1f77b4", "#d62728"])
a.set_xticks([0, 1]); a.set_xticklabels(labels)
a.set_ylabel("long-range CA-CA contacts (|i-j|>=12, <8 A)")
a.set_title("Zero tertiary packing in either paralog")
a.set_ylim(0, 5)
for x, v in zip([0, 1], [g1["long_range_contacts"], g2["long_range_contacts"]]):
    a.text(x, 0.15, str(v), ha="center", fontsize=14, fontweight="bold")

a = ax[1, 0]
a.bar([0, 1], [g1["Rg_ratio"], g2["Rg_ratio"]], color=["#1f77b4", "#d62728"])
a.axhline(1.0, ls="--", c="grey"); a.set_xticks([0, 1]); a.set_xticklabels(labels)
a.set_ylabel("Rg / 2.2*N^0.38"); a.set_title("Radius of gyration vs globular expectation")

a = ax[1, 1]
a.axis("off")
blkstr = "".join(ICY1[i-1] for (i, j) in blk)
atgstr = "".join(ATG41[j-1] for (i, j) in blk)
mid = "".join("|" if x == y else (":" if sc(x, y) > 0 else " ") for x, y in zip(blkstr, atgstr))
a.text(0.0, 0.9, "Conserved ICY1 block 106-127 aligned to ATG41", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
a.text(0.0, 0.70, f"ICY1  {blk[0][0]:>4} {blkstr} {blk[-1][0]}", family="monospace", fontsize=10)
a.text(0.0, 0.60, f"           {mid}", family="monospace", fontsize=10)
a.text(0.0, 0.50, f"ATG41 {blk[0][1]:>4} {atgstr} {blk[-1][1]}", family="monospace", fontsize=10)
a.text(0.0, 0.30, f"Full-length SW: score {score:.0f}, {100*ident/alen:.1f}% identity over {alen} positions\n"
                  f"Block identity: {sum(1 for (i,j) in blk if ICY1[i-1]==ATG41[j-1])}/{len(blk)}",
       fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
pd.DataFrame([g1, g2]).to_csv("ICY1_ATG41_paralog_geometry.csv", index=False)
